news.title: NVIDIA 分享 Nemotron 在信息学与数学奥赛任务中的专门化训练
news.body: 团队通过监督微调、强化学习和反馈推理，将 Nemotron 系列用于 IOI 编程与 IMO 证明任务，并报告金牌水平表现。IOI 测试是遵循竞赛约束的非官方评测，未进入正式排名；两类任务使用专门化系统，不能视为通用能力的统一证明。
news.title_original: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO

news.title: MIT 超算团队持续梳理 AI 加速器硬件演进
news.body: 林肯实验室超算中心介绍自 2018 年开展的 AI 计算调查，汇总商用加速器的峰值性能和功率。硬件比较涵盖不同架构，峰值指标不能直接替代具体工作负载的实际速度与能效。
news.title_original: Supercomputing researchers document evolution of AI hardware
news.body_original: An ongoing survey tracks the latest AI accelerator systems to keep hardware relevant for Lincoln Laboratory staff and sponsors.

news.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大企业知识和智能体合作
news.body: 双方计划将模型能力与 Teamwork Graph 的项目、文档和决策上下文结合，支持 Rovo 及现有工作流程。公告也讨论更深入的 Jira 集成探索，访问仍受权限约束，规划功能不能都视为已经上线。
news.title_original: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
news.body_original: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

news.title: Google 用地理空间基础模型探索公共卫生数据缺口
news.body: Google 介绍 Population Dynamics Foundation Model 的五个合作案例，将预训练地点表征作为现有流行病学流程的输入。目标是缓解报告滞后与数据稀疏，案例结果仍需在具体地区和健康任务中验证。
news.title_original: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health

news.title: Chris Bourg 获任 MIT 副教务长及冠名图书馆馆长
news.body: MIT 宣布 Chris Bourg 新任职衔及图书馆馆长职位的捐赠支持，强调数字时代的知识获取和保存使命。报道回顾开放出版与数字内容工作，属于组织与教育动态。
news.title_original: Chris Bourg named vice provost and Barbara K. Ostrom (1978) Director of the MIT Libraries
news.body_original: As director, Bourg has focused on digital access, open and equitable scholarly publishing, and expanded support for data-intensive research.

news.title: Jump Trading 分享用 ChatGPT 扩展量化研究的实践
news.body: OpenAI 客户案例介绍 Jump Trading 将智能体用于较长周期的编码与研究分析，由研究人员定义目标、评价标准和受控环境。案例强调监控与人工复核，没有证明某种交易策略的收益。
news.title_original: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
news.body_original: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

news.title: OpenAI 公开 AI 数学研究结果与部分 Lean 形式化证明
news.body: OpenAI 将内部模型得到的数学结果、修订和引用规则公开到 GitHub，并分享部分 Lean 形式化、推理摘要及计算投入信息。发布强调社区反馈与透明度，不意味着每项结果都已完成独立审查。
news.body_original: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

news.title: MIT 启动面向美国多学段的 STEM 教育计划
news.body: MIT for America 计划覆盖从幼儿园到社区学院的学习阶段，重点包括数学、动手设计制造与建设性使用 AI。公告描述项目目标和安排，不应把预期教育收益当成已验证结果。
news.title_original: MIT announces the MIT for America initiative, to strengthen STEM education across the country
news.body_original: The effort aims to help U.S. learners from kindergarten to community college, with an emphasis on math, making, and the constructive use of AI.

news.title: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 用合同流程训练和评估计算机操作智能体
news.body: 合作把合同配置、审批与可复用条款整理为 11 项研究任务，逐项检验业务要求是否满足。Astra 在该内部评估中优于所比较的 Sol 配置，但平均评分仍有明显改进空间，不能等同于可无监督完成所有法律工作。
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

news.title: Falcon-Emirati 聚焦阿联酋阿拉伯语方言与文化语境
news.body: 团队在 Falcon-H1-Arabic 基础上开发 7B 方言专用模型，目标是理解阿联酋口语、诗歌和谚语中的语义与文化背景。文章强调标准阿拉伯语能力不能替代方言理解，实际适用性仍需场景化评估。
news.title_original: Falcon-Emirati: When an LLM Learns the Dialect, the Culture, and the Nuance

news.title: Google 报告讨论智能体隐私与安全的情境边界
news.body: 工作坊报告借鉴情境完整性理论，提出应以具体场景的行为规范约束智能体，并在系统、模型、用户与生态层面协调防护。报告梳理开放研究问题，不能视为这些安全难题已经解决。
news.title_original: Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle

news.title: OpenAI 公布面向欧盟的文本水印方案及其局限
news.body: OpenAI 宣布为部分 API 模型提供自愿启用水印，并计划逐步在欧盟符合条件的 ChatGPT 与 Codex 文本中加入统计水印。检测存在漏报与误报，短文本、编辑和翻译会影响效果；水印不能证明内容真实或确定作者责任。
news.title_original: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
news.body_original: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

news.title: OpenAI 宣布测试 ChatGPT 视觉广告并扩展效果测量
news.body: OpenAI 计划本月稍晚先在美国的图像生成场景测试新视觉广告形式，广告会单独标注，并与生成图像分开。公司同时扩展转化与归因合作以及品牌适配评估试点；公告中的早期客户结果不能视为普遍广告效果保证。
news.title_original: Building advertising for the way people use AI
news.body_original: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

news.title: ThinkingBox：用后台状态检验智能体是否真正完成任务
news.body: 微软介绍覆盖 507 个有状态业务流程的评测，每项任务重复运行 20 次，检查最终数据库状态与副作用。文章强调工具调用成功和流畅回复不能替代结果验证，单次成功也不能证明重复执行可靠；结论限于所测任务与配置。
news.title_original: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.

news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 系列模型使用指南
news.body: 官方指南讨论如何按任务选择模型、控制成本与延迟，并用清晰指令、上下文管理和持续评估支持长任务。指南强调上线前检验任务成功率及数据控制，不能把示例能力视为所有场景下的保证。
news.title_original: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
news.body_original: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.

papers.title: CrystalJev：用校准概率决定材料筛选何时需要慢计算
papers.body: arXiv:2610.06985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomistic foundation models triage millions of hypothetical materials but are used as slow simulators, their thresholded energies taken at face value. They are better read as fast decision-makers. CrystalJev queries a frozen interatomic potential once per unrelaxed structure and answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities, finite-sample guarantees and a rule for when to think slowly. Across 65 Matbench Discovery models, a 'stable' call is a probability in disguise, explained by a model's errors and the candidate population. papers.title: 神经网络势模拟 V-Ti-Cr 合金力学性质
papers.body: arXiv:2610.08291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials enable large-scale atomistic simulations of vanadium alloys relevant to fusion applications, but reliable training and validation remain challenging in multicomponent systems. Here, we develop a descriptor-based DeepMD-DPA1 potential for the V-Ti-Cr system using a two-stage workflow: broad configuration sampling driven by the MatterSim foundation model followed by fine-tuning to density-functional-theory data computed with VASP. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. papers.title: Paimon：可扩展的原子模拟智能体框架
papers.body: arXiv:2606.09422v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle.
